periods.label: 破城舰

appearance.overview: Large bald male student in a long uniform, wielding a huge zanbatō Device.

personality.summary: Bold, old-fashioned and proud of direct frontal challenge, declaring that a Japanese man never retreats.

relationships.stella-vermillion: Opponent who overpowers his ten-ton strike head-on.
relationships.renren-tomaru: Ranked just below her and poorly matched against her speed.

periods.summary: Rai challenges Stella in her ninth selection battle. He reveals that each swing of his zanbatō accumulates weight up to ten tons and attacks with Crescendo Axe. Stella deliberately receives the blow, overpowers it with raw A-rank strength, and blasts him unconscious at close range.

key_events.summary: Stella defeats Rai by overpowering his fully charged heavy slash.

periods.time: During the raid on Dragunov's Shinjuku underground arena
periods.label: 强音碎击击溃国王

status.current: defeats Dragunov arena's King with a new wide-area strike
status.condition: has grown after realizing his old Crescendo Axe was too controlled and limited

relationships.kikyo-hagure: Protects her and Botan from King's giant club.
relationships.botan-hagure: Protects her and coordinates the raid.
relationships.stella-vermillion: His past loss to Stella informs his new method of overloading Crescendo Axe.

periods.summary: Rai participates in the Hagun raid on Dragunov's illegal arena. He saves the Hagure sisters from the giant arena champion King, then confronts him with an evolution of Crescendo Axe. Instead of limiting accumulated weight to what he can precisely control, Rai lets the enormous mass spin out through his whole body and changes blade angle to convert the rotation into a pressure-wave tsunami, Forzato Smash, blowing away King and almost all remaining fighters in one attack.

key_events.summary: Uses Forzato Smash to defeat King and end the arena melee.
